## Deep Badger (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
N Large animal  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 30 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 77 (7d8+21)  
**Fort** +8, **Ref** +7, **Will** +3  


**Offense**


**Speed** 25 ft., burrow 20 ft. (stone 10 ft.)  
**Melee** bite +9 (1d4+4), 2 claws +6 (1d4+2)  


**Tactics**


**Before Combat** Deep badgers dig around their prey, making the area into difficult terrain for creatures that lack a burrow speed.  

**During Combat** Deep badgers grapple a target, attempting to drag them down into the earth to suffocate (retrieving the body later and moving to engage other opponents in the meanwhile).  

**Morale** Deep badgers fight to the death to defend their territory; if encountered elsewhere, a deep badger flees at 12 hp or less.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 18, **Dex** 15, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, Wis 12, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 23 (27 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Grapple, Multiattack, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +6, Climb +8, Perception +5, Stealth +4, Survival +5  
**SQ** terra burrowing  



**Ecology**


**Environment** underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or den (4-10)  
**Treasure** none
